'''Fortification''' is a stackable [[buff]]. Entities inherently have 1% less [[damage taken]] from [[hit]]s per stack of Fortification. By default, it has a maximum of 20 stacks and lasts 6 seconds. The amount of stacks gained per hit depends on a combination of the hit's damage, the enemy's ailment threshold, and the enemy's rarity. 

__TOC__

==Mechanics==
{{for|more information|Damage calculation}}

When you hit an enemy with a fortifying hit, you will gain a variable number of stacks, based on the target's [[damage taken]], that target's [[ailment threshold]], and its [[rarity]]. The Fortification generation bonus against magic, rare, and unique monsters may cause you to generate more stacks against a map boss than a normal monster in the same map, despite the boss's higher ailment threshold. There is no minimum number of stacks; insufficient damage can cause a hit to grant 0 stacks, even with {{c|mod|100% chance to Fortify}}. 

The fortification calculation ignores some forms of [[mitigation]], for example against monsters in the [[Azurite Mine]], [[Simulacrum]], or monsters that have just been spawned by certain league mechanics.<ref>[[Version_3.17.0#Fortification_and_Damage_Reduction|3.17.0: Fortification and Damage Reduction]]</ref> It does not ignore regular mitigation such as [[damage reduction]] (from armour).<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qnVEaayhs3s</ref> 

You can only gain Fortification stacks from one hit every 0.1 seconds, and each instance of stacks gained lasts for the default Fortification duration without refreshing any other instance. For example, if you gain 5 stacks from one hit, 6 stacks from another hit a second later, and then 7 stacks from a third hit, when the first instance of 5 stacks expires you will be left with 13 stacks from the remaining instances.

Instances are tracked even when you are at maximum Fortification, so if you gain 18 stacks from one hit, then 18 from another hit, bringing you to the Fortification limit of 20, gaining another 18 stacks from a third hit will not change your displayed Fortification, but when the first instance expires you will still have a total of 36 stacks, and therefore still be at maximum Fortification. Up to 100 instances of Fortification can be tracked this way.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/PathOfExileBuilds/comments/wqp5mu/comment/ikuq1vh/</ref>

Fortification stacks do not grant less damage taken; entities inherently take less damage for having Fortification, similar to how stats are gained for having [[Rage]] or [[Charge]]s. The buff itself grants nothing.<ref>https://discord.com/channels/174993814845521922/174994219390337024/971604298968469575</ref> This means increasing [[Buff Effect]] (with {{il|Ichimonji}}) has no effect on Fortification.

The Fortification mastery that grants {{c|mod|Recover 100 Life for each Fortification Lost}} does not recover life when you lose instances of Fortification while you are still at the maximum; you only gain life when your displayed amount of Fortification decreases.

{{c|mod|#% less Damage taken}} modifiers are calculated after [[armour]], [[resistance]]s, and [[endurance charge]]s.<ref name="DMGTakenMods" />
For more detail, refer to [[Receiving Damage]].

==Sources of Fortification==
Fortification can be gained by multiples sources which split into two categories, those that go through regular rules of Fortification ([[Hit]]) and those that works as [[buff]] with a limited amount of Fortification. The sources are the following:

On [[Hit]]:
* {{il|Fortify Support}}
* {{il|Vigilant Strike}}
* {{c|mod|Melee Hits Fortify, -3 to maximum Fortification}} [[Fortify Mastery]]
* {{il|Bound By Destiny}} w/ {{c|mod|Melee Hits Fortify if 6 Warlord Items are Equipped}}
* {{c|mod|Melee hits Fortify}} [[corrupted]] weapon implicit mod
* [[Tombfist]] w/ {{c|mod|With a Murderous Eye Jewel Socketed, Melee Hits have 25% chance to Fortify}}
* {{il|The Celestial Brace}} (with [[strike]] skills)
* {{psl|Crushing Reply}} (with [[Retaliation]] skills)
* {{psl|Overlord}} [[Cluster Jewel]] notable (requires maces, sceptres or staves)
* [[Ascendant|Ascendant's]] ascendancy notable {{psl|id=AscendancyAscendant42}} (50% chance on melee hit)
* {{il|Perseverance}} (on melee [[stun]])
* Elder/Shaper influenced belt mod {{c|mod|Melee Hits which Stun have (8—12)% chance to Fortify}}
* {{il|Tattoo of the Tukohama Warrior}} (5% chance on melee stun)
* {{il|Runegraft of Rallying}} (per [[Valour]] spent to place a [[banner]])

[[Buff]]s:
* [[Champion]]'s {{psl|Fortitude}} ascendancy passive skill grants maximum Fortification at all times to the player and nearby allies.
* {{il|Kingmaker}} grants +10 Fortification to nearby allies.

Legacy sources only available in [[permanent leagues]]
* {{il|Honoured Tattoo of the Pa}} on a +30 Strength notable passive
* Helmet [[Labyrinth enchantment]] for {{il|Shattering Steel}}, when at close range
* {{il|Overwhelming Odds}} jewel with {{il|Cleave}}

==Maximum Fortification stacks==
Default maximum stacks is 20. Additional stacks can be attained from the following sources:

* +6 stacks from 4 skill tree nodes including [[Steadfast]], and 3 [[Fortify#Passive skills|small skill nodes]]

* +12 stacks from [[Volatile Vaal Orb|corrupted]] {{il|The Celestial Brace}}

* +18 stacks from corrupted [[Beacon of Madness]], but only while affected by {{stl|Glorious Madness}}

* +1 stack per Endurance charge from {{il|Replica Badge of the Brotherhood}}

* +8​ stacks added to passives by {{il|Lethal Pride}} 14118 or 15613 socketed​ near {{psl|Iron Reflexes}} (Duelist: 54127).

* +12 stacks from the corrupted [[veiled mod]] {{ml|JunMasterVeiledFortifyEffectWhileFocused_|display=stat_text}}, but only while you have {{sl|Focus}} (Crafting Bench versions are +6/+7)

* +5 stacks from a double legacy {{il|Penitent Mask}} helmet base type or its sister variants

If it was possible, increasing the maximum Fortification by 80 stacks would provide 100% less damage taken from hits.

==Items==
===Base items===
The following base items are related to Fortify:
{{Drop enabled base item table
|where=(items.stat_text LIKE "%Fortification%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Fortify%" )
  AND items.class_id NOT IN ("Active Skill Gem", "Support Skill Gem")
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

Legacy versions of {{il|Sorrow Mask}}, {{il|Atonement Mask}}, and {{il|Penitent Mask}} grant additional maximum Fortification.

===Unique Items===
The following [[unique item]]s are related to Fortify:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%Fortify%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%Fortifies%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant bonuses to Fortify:

===Base passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%fortification%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%fortify%"
}}
===Cluster jewel passives===
{{Passive skill table
|q_tables = passive_skill_stats
|q_join = passive_skills._pageName = passive_skill_stats._pageName
|q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "%affliction%" AND (passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%fortification%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%fortify%")
|large= 1
|stat_text	=1
}}

===Ascendancy passives===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%fortify%" OR

}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.19.0|
* Melee hits that can Fortify now generate roughly twice as many Fortification stacks as previously, based on damage dealt. Fortification generation against magic and rare monsters has been further increased.
* The base duration of Fortification has been increased to 6 seconds (previously 5).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.17.0|
* Fortification generation now ignores the target's damage reduction. 
}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* Sources of Fortify now grant a number of stacks of Fortification based on the percentage of the enemy's ailment threshold dealt by the hit that applied Fortify to you, with a large bonus to fortification stack generation against rare and unique monsters. 
* You have 1% less damage taken from hits for each stack of Fortification, and Fortification lasts 5 seconds by default. Fortification from multiple melee hits or different sources stacks, up to a default cap of 20 stacks. You can only gain Fortification stacks from one hit every 0.1 seconds.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.9.0|
* Fortify's damage reduction effect is now multiplicative with other similar effects.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.0.0|
* Introduced to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
